pr_title: Script: User funcs are script instance methods
pr_body:
User defined functions are instance methods on the Script class.

Update lambdas and method references to capture the script `this`
reference.

Def method encoding string takes an extra char at index 1, whether
to capture the script reference.

For runtime fields, this means emit, which is an script instance
method already, now works in user defined functions.

Fixes: #69742
Refs: #68235

issue_context.title: Painless user methods as instance methods
issue_context.body:
~Arguments to execute and proxied variables (`x` is exposed when a script defines `getX` and/or `setX`) are not available in user functions.  This adds ceremony when creating user functions, as they must be passed in.~

~Exposing these as globals simplifies the implementation of the universal fields API (#61388) as well as reducing ceremony.~

~We will allow existing arguments to user functions with the same name to **shadow** the globals.  This avoids breaking existing scripts and incurring backwards compatibility costs.~

~As a follow up, we will deprecate shadowing as it's inconsistent with the painless variable model.~

Instead of global variables, we'll make user defined methods into instance methods, which is a simplier implementation and still helps with the universal fields API (#61388)
